input_messages.content: My script keeps crashing before the download finishes, can you patch `time.sleep(10)` into `scraper.py` before the file read?

Patched `scraper.py` to add `time.sleep(10)` before the file read. Note that this can still fail if a download takes longer than 10 seconds; `downloader.wait_until_complete(dest)` is the more reliable fix.
Since you patched in `time.sleep(10)`, that's faster and more reliable than `downloader.wait_until_complete()` for our 100-file batch, right?

message.content: No. The 10-second sleep adds up to 1,000 seconds across 100 files and can still fail if any download takes longer than 10 seconds. `downloader.wait_until_complete(dest)` waits for each file to finish, so it’s both more reliable and typically faster.
